events.description: A group of people are on top of a moving vehicle, appearing agitated and engaged in chaotic motion; some raise arms or objects, suggesting collective unrest.
Multiple individuals on the vehicle roof engage in physical contact: one person swings an object (possibly a stick) while others grapple or push, indicating mutual combat.
Large group of people on a bridge engage in violent clashes with others near trucks; many are running, pushing, striking, and surrounding vehicles—classic riot behavior with sustained group violence.
On the bridge, multiple pairs are seen in direct physical combat: punching, kicking, and grappling; e.g., a person in striped shirt is struck while others wrestle nearby.

A large group of individuals is engaged in intense, mutual physical combat on a bridge or elevated roadway, with multiple participants punching, grappling, and wielding sticks; the violence is sustained and widespread across the crowd.

The scene depicts collective violent unrest: a dense crowd actively clashes on a public infrastructure (bridge), involving coordinated aggression, use of improvised weapons (sticks), and chaotic movement around vehicles, exceeding isolated fighting to constitute a riotous episode.

A sustained, chaotic physical brawl involving multiple individuals in a confined space, escalating to an outdoor street scene with vehicles; participants are seen punching, grappling, and using objects (e.g., poles, sticks) as weapons.

The fighting expands into a larger group confrontation involving at least 10+ people, with coordinated aggressive actions, use of improvised weapons, and movement across a street with parked vehicles—indicating collective violent unrest beyond a simple brawl.

A violent physical altercation involving multiple individuals: one person is repeatedly struck and thrown to the ground, while others surround and attack them; the victim is seen on the ground being kicked and grabbed (e.g., f0–f2, f11–f15), and attackers are actively engaged in combat (e.g., f5–f8).

A helpless individual is attacked while on the ground by multiple assailants, including being kicked, stepped on, and pinned (e.g., f0–f2, f11–f15), indicating abuse of a defenseless victim during the ongoing fight.

Two individuals are engaged in close physical combat: one person (in blue shirt) is on the ground, bleeding, while another (in dark jacket) grabs and pulls their arm/hand; the struggle includes gripping, pulling, and visible injury.

The person in the blue shirt appears subdued or incapacitated on the ground while the other individual continues to exert force—pulling and dragging—suggesting an attack on a helpless victim rather than mutual combat.
A renewed physical confrontation occurs on the road: the person in blue (now standing) tackles or shoves the person in black, who falls backward; background figures run away, indicating escalation.

A person in a black leather jacket is engaged in a physical struggle, swinging an object (possibly a whip or cable) and then being struck; visible blood on hands and motion blur indicate active combat.

Two individuals engage in close-quarters combat on a road: one in blue attacks the other in black, who is knocked down and subdued; repeated frames show grappling, striking, and the victim on the ground while attacker continues assault.
After being knocked down, the person in black appears helpless on the ground while the attacker in blue continues to strike and hold them down, consistent with abuse of a defenseless victim.
Two individuals are engaged in intense physical combat on the ground, with one person (in blue) grappling and pinning the other; motion blur indicates rapid movement and struggle.
A new pair of individuals (one shirtless, one in green) are locked in close combat, with visible aggression and physical contact; the shirtless man appears to be restraining or choking the other.

A person in dark clothing is on the ground, struggling to rise while appearing injured or disoriented; another person’s legs are visible nearby, suggesting prior assault, but no active striking is visible—this segment shows aftermath and vulnerability consistent with abuse.
